entities.summary: The Pontifical Catholic University of Chile is a traditional private university based in Santiago, Chile. It is one of the thirteen Catholic universities existing in the Chilean university system and one of the two pontifical universities in the country, along with the Pontifical Catholic University of Valparaíso. It is ranked among the top universities in Latin America. Pontifical Catholic University of Chile is a university in Santiago, established in 1888. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
